cves.description: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere (CWE-668) in FileArtifactService in Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) for Python (google-adk) versions 1.19.0 before 1.39.1 and 2.0.0a1 before 2.7.0 allows a caller in one application to list, read, overwrite, or delete artifacts belonging to another application when both applications share a FileArtifactService root directory and use the same user_id (and session_id for session-scoped artifacts). FileArtifactService accepted app_name across its public API methods but omitted app_name when constructing on-disk paths (root/users/{user_id}/... instead of root/apps/{app_name}/users/{user_id}/...). Version 2.6.0 scoped writes by app_name but retained a legacy root/users/{user_id} fallback for reads and deletes; version 2.7.0 and the 1.x backport in version 1.39.1 removed the fallback and enforce full per-app path scoping.

📦 受影响组件：Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) for Python
🔓 漏洞类型：CWE-668 (CWE-668)
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性
